THE CLAUSE

In ChatGPT, conversations may grow so long that the model cannot process the entire history. In this case, the conversation will be truncated, using a scheme that prioritizes the newest and most relevant information. The user may not be aware of this truncation or which parts of the conversation the model can actually see.

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 a conversation may grow so long that the model cannot process the entire history
  C2 in that case the conversation is truncated
  C3 the truncation scheme prioritizes the newest and most relevant information
  C4 the user may not be aware of the truncation or of which parts of the conversation the model can actually see

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «a conversation is a list of messages, each containing a role and content; roles determine authority of instructions»
  1. «conversation C has grown so long that the model cannot process the entire history»
  2. «conversation C is truncated because it is too long for the model to process in full»
  3. «the truncation scheme for conversation C prioritizes the newest and most relevant information»
  4. «the user may not be aware that conversation C was truncated or which parts of it the model can actually see»
  5. C is «conversation C is truncated» when «conversation C has grown so long that the model cannot process the entire history»
  6. C is «the truncation scheme for conversation C prioritizes the newest and most relevant information» when «conversation C is truncated»
  7. C is «the user may not be aware of the truncation of conversation C or which parts the model can see» when «conversation C is truncated»
